Geodatastyrelsen is a Danish public authority responsible for providing national geospatial data. In the context of the annual "Atrieflimren i Danmark" (Atrial Fibrillation in Denmark) report, geodata from Geodatastyrelsen—specifically utilizing the UTM32/EUREF89 coordinate reference system from May 2015—is used to produce the national map for [[indikator-7|Indikator 7]] at the health cluster level [^src1]. This mapping allows for the geographic visualization of healthcare quality metrics, such as the incidence of severe bleeding among patients with existing atrial fibrillation, across different administrative regions. Because the provided corpus only references the agency as the data source for this specific map, no further details regarding Geodatastyrelsen's broader operations, history, or other initiatives are available.
